test_title: PYST 62: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In 2025, India celebrated the 10th anniversary of which major urban development scheme?

options.text: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Smart City Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Smart Cities Mission** (SCM) was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **June 25, 2015**. Since it completes a decade of implementation in **2025**, the nation celebrates its **10th anniversary**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Smart City Mission.***
 
• The mission was designed to promote **100 cities** that provide core infrastructure, a clean and sustainable environment, and a decent quality of life to their citizens through the application of **"Smart Solutions"**.
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme where the **Central Government** provides financial support to the tune of **Rs. 48,000 crore** over five years, with a matching contribution from the **State Governments** and **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)**.
 
• The implementation of the mission is done by a **Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)** at the city level. Each SPV is headed by a full-time **CEO** and has nominees from the Central Government, State Government, and the ULB on its Board.
 
• The strategic components of the **Smart Cities Mission** include **City Improvement (Retrofitting)**, **City Renewal (Redevelopment)**, and **City Extension (Greenfield Development)**, plus a **Pan-city initiative** in which Smart Solutions are applied covering larger parts of the city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)**:
 
 
• Launched on **June 25, 2015**, alongside the Smart City Mission. While it also celebrates its **10th anniversary** in **2025**, the question specifically focuses on the urban development scheme often highlighted for its "Smart" technological interventions.
 
• It covers **500 cities** and focuses on establishing infrastructure that could ensure adequate robust **sewage networks** and **water supply** for urban transformation.
 
• In **October 2021**, **AMRUT 2.0** was launched to make cities **'water secure'** and provide functional tap connections to all households in all statutory towns.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)**:
 
 
• Launched on **June 25, 2015**, with the objective of providing **"Housing for All"** by the year 2022 (later extended).
 
• It addresses urban housing shortage among the **EWS/LIG** and **MIG** categories, including slum dwellers, by ensuring a **pucca house** to all eligible urban households.
 
• The mission has four verticals: **In-situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR)**, **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**, **Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)**, and **Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction (BLC)**.
 
 
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (Urban)**:
 
 
• Launched on **October 2, 2014**, to accelerate the efforts to achieve universal sanitation coverage.
 
• By **2025**, it would be in its **11th year** of implementation, having transitioned into **SBM-U 2.0** in **2021**, focusing on **Garbage Free Cities**.
 
• It aims at **100% scientific management** of municipal solid waste and making all statutory towns **Open Defecation Free (ODF)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Nodal Ministry**: All the schemes mentioned above (SCM, AMRUT, PMAY-U, and SBM-U) are governed by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)**, Government of India.
 
• **Integrated Command and Control Centers (ICCC)**: One of the most significant achievements of the **Smart City Mission** is the operationalization of **ICCCs** in almost all 100 cities, which acted as war rooms during the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• **Data and Impact**: As of recent reports, over **8,000 projects** worth more than **Rs. 1.6 lakh crore** have been part of the SCM pipeline, significantly impacting **urban mobility**, **public safety**, and **environmental monitoring**.
</ul
